card.name: Digits in small-sample percentages
card.fires_on: A digit inside a percentage in parentheses, usually the 5, 0 or 2 in values like 25%, 50% or 100%, when it follows a small count such as 1/4 or 2/6. Seen in immune-reaction recurrence and resolution statements.

modes.label: Recurrence after restarting
modes.description: Percentage digit in a statement about how many patients had a recurrence after the drug was restarted.
modes.example: of these, 1/4 (2<<5>>%) had recurrence of nephritis.

modes.label: Fraction tables
modes.description: Leading digit of a percentage right after a small fraction in a table row.
